newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Austrian furniture maker buys Bulgaria's Bules.
newsitem.headline: Austrian furniture maker buys Bulgaria's Bules.

text.p: Austrian furniture producer Kaindl Kronopsan GR bought 51 percent of Bulgarian timber manufacturer Bules for $3.2 million, the privatisation agency said in a statement on Monday.
"A contract for the sale of 51 percent of Bules EAD to Kaindl Kronospan was completed on May 26," said the statement.
Based in the Black Sea port of Bourgas, Bules is a major local producer of furniture and timber goods used in construction.

Under the deal the buyer is due transfer $3.2 million in ten days after signing the contract, to invest a further $7 million in the next five years and retain the plant's 940 employees for three years.
Under Bulgarian privatisation law 15 percent in Bules are to be offered to its employees in non-voting shares and 25 percent were offered for mass privatisation.
